projection: south polar stereographic, sphere R=1737.4 km, lon 0 up, 90E right (LOLA/PDS)

hillshade.lightAzimuthFrom: clockwise from image up (the lon 0 direction)

tint.formula: grey = clip(base + shade * hillshade + elevation * clip(zNorm, 0, 1), 0, 1); zNorm maps the given percentiles of the 320 m heights to 0..1

hillshade.note: Display shading only (artificial light direction); not a Sun position.

dem.encoding: planar-split: r = z - (left + up - upleft) with zero padding, int16 LE; stored as all low bytes then all high bytes; gzip. Decode: un-split, then z = r + left + up - upleft row-major.
dem.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_80M (80-90 S) + LDEM_75S_120M ring (to about 75 S), 400 m (custom-site horizons, light & shadow map)

inner.method: 5 x 5 block mean of the 80 m grid, rounded to 1 m

ring.method: exact-overlap area mean of the 120 m pixels on each 400 m cell (separable 1-D overlaps; per 1.2 km: weights 1,1,1,1/3 | 2/3,1,1,2/3 | 1/3,1,1,1 of 10/3 px), rounded to 1 m
ring.note: outside the inner block only; corners reach about 69 S (real LOLA heights, no fill)

seam.what: 120 m-derived minus 80 m-derived 400 m heights over the inner block's outer 5 px (and its edge pixels alone), i.e. just inside 80 S

psr.source: AVGVISIB == 0 (never sunlit over the averaging period)
